deny-by-default.rule: Every permission decision routes through a Policy method (allowsFsRead/allowsFsWrite/allowsSocket/allowsNetwork). When a permission domain is declared (present in the block), any target not matched by a declared pattern in that domain returns false; an absent domain or absent block returns true (legacy compat). No ad-hoc comparison against SOX_PERM_* env values or raw permission arrays exists outside policy.ts.

guard-before-sink.rule: Every code path that opens or creates an OS resource from a caller-supplied path first calls the Policy guard and returns a denial (isError result, no side effect) when the policy denies. The guard precedes the resource sink (getDb/openDb), never follows it — so a denied call creates no file or directory.
